about: Confused Screaming is a screenshot of YouTuber Filthy Frank in glasses and a pale blue shirt, lunging forward with his mouth wide open in a full-volume yell while clutching a frying pan, with the caption "*Confused screaming*" across the bottom. It is a written-out sound effect, the reaction you post when something makes so little sense that words fail and only noise is left.
origin: The frame is from a Filthy Frank YouTube video posted in December 2014, in which he screams while being hit in a doorway. The captioned screenshot later spread as a reaction image in comment sections.
usage:
The caption "*Confused screaming*" is already at the bottom. The single box at the top is the setup: the statement, rule or situation that makes no sense.

It works for contradictions, weird instructions and plot holes: a teacher allowing notes in a language you do not speak, a game patch that makes things worse, a recipe that says "season to taste" for baking. One line is enough; the caption does the punchline.
ideas: when the teacher says the test is open book but the book is in another language
when the bug disappears after you add a print statement
the recipe: bake at 350 for "a while"
when your code works and you don't know why
my parents asking me to fix the printer over the phone
when the team loses to the last-place team twice
